annotations.title: Company profile and latest key metrics

description: Latest company financials from SEC filings for one ticker: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, operating income, total assets, cash, free cash flow and shares outstanding, for the latest fiscal year, latest quarter and trailing twelve months. Every number includes its period dates, the 10-K or 10-Q it came from, the filing date and a link to the SEC filing.
